9927: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
Do your reps, then switch sides.
9928: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Kick your leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
9929: Set your back against the pad and step onto the platform.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Lower into a squat with control.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
9930: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher.
As it nears your head, let the elbows travel down so the bar moves toward the upper chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Lower again along the same path and repeat.
Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.
9931: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.
9932: Lie on a bench and make sure the bands and plates are secured on the barbell.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid chest under control.
Press it back up, fighting the rising band tension.
Lock out your elbows without losing shoulder position.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.
9933: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
9939: Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.
9940: Hold a sandbag against your chest or across your shoulders and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are about 90 degrees with your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and the bag tight to your body.
9942: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
9969: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.
9971: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
9977: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
9980: Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
9986: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.
9988: Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.
9989: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back, one hand low and the other high.
Let the lower hand grip the stick as the working arm.
With the top hand, gently pull the stick up so the lower hand rises along your back.
Go until you feel a mild stretch.
Keep your shoulders level, then switch sides.
9990: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.
9994: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
9995: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
9996: Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
9999: Start in a forearm or high plank.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
